title: Paris Talks
textType: Authoritative text and recorded talk of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá
author: abdul-baha
attributionNote: Paris Talks, by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá shelf.
description: A compilation of talks given by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá during His first stay in Paris, from October to December 1911. Also included are three talks delivered during visits to England in 1912–13 and a Tablet revealed in 1913. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (‘Abdu’l‑Bahá).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
